Name: Reverse Proposal
Author: GreenOnion24
Description:
[i][size=3]
[quote]Updated it to make it playable for 1.6[/quote]
I made this mod with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded and Immersive Farm 2[/b] so the angle of the camera might be a little out of the way. I will fixed it soon for those who doesn't use the expanded mod and immersive farm 2. It will take a little while.

Hi! This is the first mod I created and I am so happy to share it with you! The Reverse proposal to become the NPC's Boyfriend/Girlfriend!! 
[/size][/i]
[i]When they reached the 8th heart and seen the 8th heart event, this event will be triggered immediately if you got on the time.
[/i]
[b][size=4]The Available NPC's for this Mod are:
[/size][/b][color=#00ff00][size=3][b]Bachelors:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]-Sebastian
-Alex
-Harvey
[/size]-Sam
-Shane
-Elliott

[b][size=4]Adding NPC in the future:[/size][/b][size=3]
[b][color=#c27ba0]Bachelorettes:[/color][/b]
-Abigail
-Haley
-Maru
-Emily
-Leah[/size]

[i][size=3]I also may Add Reverse Proposal - Marriage to the mod. I hope you guys stay tuned to this Mod, and I hope you like it![/size][/i]
[left]I added a date before proposal. It was short but I hope you like .
Available romanceable characters:
-Sebastian
-Alex[/left]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Download the mod.
3. Put the mod into your mods folder.
4. Play![/size]

[size=4][b]Future Features[/b][/size]
[size=3]-Might add more Datable NPC's reverse proposal.
-Might change the place where the reverse proposal took place. Depends on the place where the NPC's favorite place to hang out (ie. Beach, Mountain Lake(Near Robin's house).
-Adding Reverse Proposal - Marriage.

[/size]Credits:
